questions.question: Agree the account of Fibonacci’s place in European mathematics and clarify his use of the Arabic-language tradition.

localizations.source: Agree the account of Fibonacci’s place in European mathematics and clarify his use of the Arabic-language tradition.
localizations.ru: Согласовать обобщение о месте Фибоначчи в европейской математике и уточнить характер заимствований из арабоязычной традиции.

questions.resolution: The absolute claim about the “first” mathematician and all achievements was replaced by a neutral historical formulation.

questions.question: Clarify the wording of the rabbit problem and what is counted after one year.

localizations.source: Clarify the wording of the rabbit problem and what is counted after one year.
localizations.ru: Уточнить формулировку задачи о кроликах и смысл подсчёта пар через год.

questions.resolution: The RU and EN wording now consistently counts all living pairs after one year and states maturity and survival assumptions.
